name: handsfree
description: One line for your Claude Code: make a site voice + gesture controllable. The skill audits the codebase, registers the page's capabilities as WebMCP tools (document.modelContext.registerTool), then injects handsfree.js — a runtime that routes Web Speech transcripts and MediaPipe hand gestures (index finger as a projected cursor, fist to click, left/right side bands that scroll up or down faster towards the edges, all drawn as a translucent grey particle overlay) to those tools with no LLM in the loop. Say "handsfree" or "make this site voice/gesture controlled" to start.
